'''Inner Teth''' was the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Teth/Legends|Teth]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="TCWCG" /> The [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] eventually replaced Inner Teth with a newly built capital, [[Peroon]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Inner Teth was mentioned in the [[2010]] roleplaying game sourcebook ''[[The Clone Wars Campaign Guide]]'', published by [[Wizards of the Coast]].<ref name="TCWCG" />
